label: copy-phase input d, late in long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost only when the fed-back input is the letter d (98% of activation mass; a little on r, 1.6%). It never fires in the original or delimiter phases. Activation rises steeply with absolute step: zero before t=8, and about 70% of mass at t>=15, so it is concentrated in L=8-9 sequences near the end of the copy. Inputs of d at early copy steps rarely fire it. Restricting to t>=13 captures 89% of the mass but only a third of those steps are active. Among late copy-phase d inputs, outputs of d or r raise the firing rate somewhat, but the remaining precision gap is not explained. It does not fire on first occurrences of any token or on other letters or digits.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: d, r, f, -, k, 3; least: t, 0, n, h) and the token being output (most: d, r, k, u, o, i; least: z, 1, q, -); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=7, t=17, recall_idx=8.
